End date (verifier) is 2023-12-26, a same-day handover. He gave his 이임사 as 국가보훈부 장관 on the morning of 2023-12-26 (korea.kr 연설일 2023.12.26), the day his successor's appointment took effect and she took office that afternoon. The ministry's official list gives 2023-12-25 by its day-before-successor convention. issues.desc: End dates of 박민식 and 강정애 were moved by the verifier from the MPVA list's day-before values (2023-12-25, 2025-07-24) to same-day handovers (2023-12-26, 2025-07-25). Each gave the 이임사 as minister on the successor's appointment day (korea.kr 연설일 2023.12.26 and 2025.07.25), and the 2025 successor was only approved around midday on 07-25. The MPVA list applies a mechanical day-before rule (its 처장 page even contradicts the gazette for 박민식's 2022 start). No exit notice is printed in the gazette, so both ends stay at medium confidence. A day-before coding would move each end one day earlier.

박민식's spell is flagged reorg_continuation=true and reappointed_on_reorg=true because he held 국가보훈처장 up to the 2023-06-05 reorganization and was appointed 국가보훈부장관 by a new notice that day. The predecessor office was not a 국무위원 post and is out of scope, so there is no predecessor spell in this lineage. Panel code must not try to merge or chain it.

The unverified lead that the 국가보훈처장 was never a 국무위원 agrees with offices.json (OF068). The lineage therefore has no spells before 2023-06-05. The transcript inputs also carry no 국가보훈처 speakers in the minister role.

박민식 end_reason is resigned_to_run. Formally he was replaced in the 2023-12-04 reshuffle, which the press described as 총선 차출 of heads expected to run, and he then declared for 서울 영등포을 (2024-02-15) and ran as the 국민의힘 candidate in 서울 강서을 at the 2024-04-10 general election. Code him as replaced if only the formal mechanism matters.

The old panel row for 강정애 has wrong dates (start 2023-09-01, end 2025-06-03), the 박민식 row ends 2023-12-28 instead of 2023-12-26, and the 권오을 row's confirmation_date 2025-07-15 is the hearing date, not the appointment.

Day-level continuity checked for 2023-06-05..2026-09-24 with no vacancy. 박민식 took office the day the ministry was created, and both replacements are same-day handovers (2023-12-26, 2025-07-25), re-checked by the verifier. No acting minister (직무대행) period exists, so the acting list is empty. The gazette text corpus (harvest complete, last 인사 item 2026-09-18) contains exactly three 국가보훈부장관 appointment notices (제20518호, 제20656호, 제21047호), and the likms harvest and a live likms search for terms 21-22 contain exactly three 국가보훈부장관 hearing requests (ZZ21147, ZZ21178, ZZ22055).
The NA API flags the birth dates of 박민식 and 권오을 as lunar (BIRDY_DIV_CD 음) in ALLNAMEMBER, while the per-term API flags 박민식's as solar. The dates themselves agree with ko.wikipedia and Wikidata.

권오을's in-office status at the cutoff rests on news of 2026-09-22 and 2026-09-23 and the MPVA list accessed 2026-09-25. No nomination for 국가보훈부장관 appears in likms (harvest through the 2026-09-03 requests) or in the news after 2025-07-25, and the 2026-08-30 reshuffle did not include the ministry.

Downstream risk, not a data error. 박민식's spell keeps reorg_continuation=true and reappointed_on_reorg=true, which matches the field definition (he held 국가보훈처장 up to the 2023-06-05 reorganization and was re-appointed by a new notice). But build/build_panel.py link_nominations() skips spells with reorg_continuation=true, so the appointed nomination ZZ21147 would not link to his spell, and build/finalize.py treats reorg_continuation rows as needing no hearing. He was in fact nominated, heard (2023-05-22) and appointed under 부칙 제6조 of 법률 제19228호. The predecessor office is out of scope, so no predecessor spell exists to chain to. The panel build must link ZZ21147 to this spell explicitly (or treat reorg_continuation as chaining only when an in-scope predecessor spell exists).
